column1: # Exact stock -> fork identity rewrites for termux-tools helper scripts.
# Canonical table: it is read by TermuxHelperRewrites (bootstrap extraction) and rendered into
# $PREFIX/libexec/termuxpp/helper-rewrites.tsv for the APT post-invoke hook (adapt-helpers), so the
# installer and the hook can never disagree.
# @WAKE_LOCK_ACTION@, @WAKE_UNLOCK_ACTION@) are filled from TermuxConstants. Rules are literal, never
# patterns. Java class names stay under com.termux.* and are deliberately not rewritten. Every stock
# text includes its opening quote or flag so the fork text never matches it again (idempotent).
